description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zeid
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Torcleaver (0~2), removed after using Torcleaver two times

description.name: Torcleaver Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Torcleaver level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zeid]

description.name: Torcleaver Level
description.text: Keeps track of Torcleaver level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zeid]
